headline: Packers WR Jayden Reed to undergo season-ending neck surgery
summary: Packers wide receiver Jayden Reed will undergo season-ending neck surgery and be placed on injured reserve, coach Matt LaFleur said Wednesday.

headline: Texans DT Mario Edwards Jr. Placed On IR With Torn ACL
summary: The Texans have placed defensive tackle Mario Edwards Jr. on injured reserve, the team announced. To take Edwards’ roster spot, the Texans signed defensive end Chris Braswell from their practice squad. Players on IR are required to sit out at least four games, but it does not appear Edwards will make it back at all […]

headline: Panthers CBs Jaycee Horn, Mike Jackson placed on IR
summary: The Panthers have placed starting cornerbacks Jaycee Horn (quad) and Mike Jackson (groin) on injured reserve after both were injured in the Week 3 loss to the Browns.

headline: Lamar Jackson is not practicing Wednesday
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson didn't mention any injury or illness during a press conference ahead of Wednesday's practice, so it's not clear why he was not on the field with the rest of the team.

headline: Josh Simmons dealing with bulging disc, will not practice on Wednesday
summary: The Chiefs will again be without their left tackle to start the practice week.

headline: Packers, guard Kevin Zeitler agree to one-year deal
summary: Veteran guard Kevin Zeitler signed a one-year deal with the Packers.
